{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to handling the race at the index level, prefer handling in net_processing"
    },
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supported handling the race, suggested handling all cfilter messages and pausing the peer instead of reordering messages"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supported handling the race in net_processing, objected to touching index internals"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4763387253",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Handling peer race conditions inside BaseIndex couples indexing code to P2P transport concerns and risks stalls in other callers",
      "quote": "Reading through this, I don't think this should be handled on the index level.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved the handling out of the index into net_processing",
      "author_replies": ["c:5106448059", "c:5186487219"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5186487219",
      "status_by_quote": "Added deferring of a response, we store the racing request in a PendingCFilterRequest struct in a Peer and then check it"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3759737064",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Touching index internals violates separation of concerns when GetSummary already exposes sufficient state",
      "quote": "Races in net_processing shouldn't be the business of indexes, and GetSummary() should have enough info... so I'd prefer if the index code was not touched at all",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed IsRacing and used GetSummary without touching index code",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3785273391"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785273391",
      "status_by_quote": "Removed IsRacing, now using GetSummary. No changes in GetSummary were required."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3754782852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove the benchmarking commit instead of squashing it, and mark PR as draft while commits need replacing",
      "quote": "The benchmarking commit should be removed, not squashed, presumably? It doesn't seem like it'll be useful beyond developing this PR?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "benchmark commit removed",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3785268150"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785268150",
      "status_by_quote": "Removed benchmark commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3754789371",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Use std::list instead of std::optional for pending cfilter requests to handle multiple requests and save memory",
      "quote": "Rather than an optional, I'd suggest considering std::list<PendingCFilterREquest> and using push_back to add requests to the end",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "switched to std::list with a limit",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3785270902"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785270902",
      "status_by_quote": "Changed an optional in favor of a list with up to MAX_PENDING_CFILTER_REQUESTS=2 entries."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5305915719",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Handle getcfheaders and getcfcheckpt the same as getcfilters since disconnects happen frequently for getcfheaders",
      "quote": "Based on the logs in #29655 this seems backwards -- there were more disconnects for getcfheaders than getcfilters? So I think this ought to be handled for all the cases?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed that all three messages should be handled identically",
      "author_replies": ["c:5331744681", "c:5427136075"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5331744681",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, all three cbf messages should be handled the same way."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5305915719",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Pause the peer entirely on a pending cfilter request instead of queueing cfilter responses and continuing to process other messages",
      "quote": "I wonder if it wouldn't be better to adopt the \"pause this peer\" approach, rather than queueing messages but continuing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author adopted the approach on top of ajtowns' branch and benchmarked it",
      "author_replies": ["c:5331744681", "c:5427136075"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5427136075",
      "status_by_quote": "I took some time to gain more understanding on how net_processing works and your comments make a perfect sense."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5127234440",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Compact filter calculations are slow enough that races occur occasionally even for peers not on high-bandwidth compact block relay, so the issue is worth handling",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": ["src/net_processing.cpp"]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5130725304",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Agrees that handling racing compact filter requests in net_processing makes sense to prevent disconnects and avoid delaying getblocktxn responses",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": ["src/net_processing.cpp"]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "ajtowns review of author's benchmarks and suggestions on top of the peer-pausing approach",
      "id": "c:5907939364"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Reread under schema 2: ajtowns and mzumsande stances changed to support as both support addressing the race in net_processing and their objections were either suggestions or settled interface concerns. Reclassified ajtowns' c:5305915719 claims as suggestions (scope and approach) and added his inline suggestions from rc:3754782852 and rc:3754789371. The PR is waiting on ajtowns to review the latest suggestions and benchmarks."
}
